title: Modelon Base Library
subTitle: A Powerful Foundation for Modeling Standards and Scalability
introduction: The Modelon Base Library is the core library that serves as the starting point for all Modelica-based system modeling. It provides the fundamental components and common elements required to represent physical systems, ensuring a standardized structure and high reusability when building various domain models. This library contains essential blocks for modeling across multiple fields—including electrical, mechanical, and thermal-fluid—supporting the efficient design and simulation of complex systems.

The Modelon Base Library is not merely a collection of utilities, but a foundation that provides a stable and scalable modeling environment. Through standardized interfaces and a modular structure, it maximizes compatibility with other specialized libraries and provides the flexibility for developing custom models. Furthermore, it enables a consistent workflow from the initial design stage to detailed analysis through advanced numerical computation functions and simulation support.
This library is utilized across various industries, providing a reliable foundation for complex system modeling that enhances development efficiency and improves quality.
